# HAC Intelligence — The Rojas Report
# CMS Healthcare Advisory Committee Member Intelligence
# Published: March 28, 2026

This site contains open-source intelligence on all 18 members of the CMS Healthcare Advisory Committee, announced March 27, 2026.

## Key Finding
Zero of 18 committee members have any stated interest in expanding physician ownership of hospitals.

## Pages
- / — Committee overview, composition, key findings, sector analysis
- /members/[slug] — 18 individual member profiles with career arcs, conflicts, red flags, and sources
- /pattern-analysis — Sector representation, who benefits from each focus area, POH relevance
